item.text: {"explanation":"Recursively canonicalize each event value. Arrays preserve order, while object keys are sorted lexically before serialization. JSON.stringify supplies the required ECMAScript representation for strings, booleans, null, and numbers. The state remains null because it is irrelevant.","program":"function solve(x){function encode(v){if(v===null||typeof v!=='object')return JSON.stringify(v);if(Array.isArray(v)){var a=new Array(v.length);for(var i=0;i<v.length;i++)a[i]=encode(v[i]);return '['+a.join(',')+']'}var keys=Object.keys(v).sort(),parts=new Array(keys.length);for(var j=0;j<keys.length;j++){var k=keys[j];parts[j]=JSON.stringify(k)+':'+encode(v[k])}return '{'+parts.join(',')+'}'}return {state:null,output:{key:encode(x.event.value)}}}"}
